name: Damage
description: Deals damage via an attack roll or a saving throw — its own primary damage output, not a bonus layered onto something else.

mechanics.text: Resolves as either an attack roll or a saving throw (this record's own featureParams.resolutionKind), dealing featureParams.damageType damage, optionally in an area (featureParams.areaShape/areaSize). The dice value lives in featureParams.scaling — one dice entry per spell slot/character level (a single-entry ladder for a fixed, non-scaling value) — never split out into tiers, since a scaling entry means nothing without knowing which level it belongs to. Distinct from feat.extra-damage (a bonus stacked ON TOP of an existing attack, e.g. a flaming weapon) and feat.area-damage-burst (an item's own fixed-dice area burst, no scaling axis at all) — this is for a record's own sole, primary damage source, whether that record is a spell or an item.
